answer.worked:
The given line has its zero at $x=\frac12$, so the reciprocal has vertical asymptote $x=\frac12$. The reciprocal retains the sign of $2x-1$: it is negative for $x<\frac12$ and positive for $x>\frac12$.

At $x=0$,
$$\begin{align*}y&=\frac{1}{2(0)-1}\\y&=-1.\end{align*}$$
As $x\to\frac12^-$, $y\to-\infty$; as $x\to\frac12^+$, $y\to+\infty$. As $x\to-\infty$, $y\to0^-$; as $x\to+\infty$, $y\to0^+$. These features match option B. Correct answer: B.
